subject: História
description_pt: Identificar a gênese da produção do saber histórico e analisar o significado das fontes que originaram determinadas formas de registro em sociedades e épocas distintas.

components.description_pt: Identificar as origens da produção de conhecimento histórico em diferentes sociedades
components.description_en: Identify the origins of historical knowledge production in different societies
components.cc_component_description: Evaluate the credibility and relevance of multiple sources of historical or social studies information

components.description_pt: Analisar a significância de diferentes tipos de fontes para registro de memória em sociedades e períodos
components.description_en: Analyze the significance of different types of sources for record-keeping across societies and periods
components.cc_component_description: Determine the type, point of view, and potential use of sources for answering historical questions

components.description_pt: Distinguir entre diferentes formas de registro histórico e suas funções na preservação da memória
components.description_en: Distinguish between different forms of historical record and their functions in preserving memory
components.cc_component_description: Recount sequences of historical events and their societal impacts in an argument

components.description_pt: Explicar como a escolha de fontes molda a construção do conhecimento histórico
components.description_en: Explain how the choice of sources shapes the construction of historical knowledge
components.cc_component_description: Analyze how an author's choice of evidence shapes their presentation of a topic

cc_matches.description: Integrate and evaluate multiple sources of information presented in diverse formats and media (e.g., visually, quantitatively, as well as in words) in order to address a question or solve a problem.

Multilingual learners will interpret social studies explanations by
* Determining multiple types of sources, points of view in sources, and __potential uses__ of sources for answering compelling and supporting questions about phenomena or events
* Analyzing sources for logical relationships among contributing factors, causes, or __related concepts__
* Evaluating experts’ points of agreement __and disagreement based on their consistency with explanation given its purpose__
Analyze how two or more authors writing about the same topic shape their presentations of key information by emphasizing different evidence or advancing different interpretations of facts.

Por medio de su repertorio lingüístico y utilizando artefactos multimodales, los estudiantes bi/multilingües podrán expresar argumentos para...
* presentar información fundamentada con evidencia de múltiples fuentes
* recalcar varias perspectivas
* establecer relaciones entre posturas y contra posturas mediante evidencia y razonamiento
* fortalecer fundamentos con intención
* reseñar secuencias de eventos y sus impactos en la sociedad
* refutar la credibilidad de evidencia
